definition: Seconds from the nearest perpetual funding settlement, which falls every interval seconds from 00:00 UTC, negative before it and positive after.
boundaries: interval divides the day: 28800 for an eight-hour venue, 3600 for Hyperliquid's hourly funding; the instrument record's funding_interval holds the venue's value. A venue that moves its funding times is not modelled. Bars without a time are missing. QML's unit runtime does not yet pass a bars input its time, so inside a unit this value stays missing until it does.
recognition: A perp unit exits before a settlement it would pay.

sources.quote: The funding rate on Hyperliquid is paid every hour
interest rate component is predetermined at 0.01% every 8 hours

golden.reference: local event times from zoneinfo (the IANA tz database), in qml/tests/golden/beyond-fx/reference_run.py
